analysis.executiveSummary: Badland Banditos requested a trade proposal to acquire Amon-Ra St. Brown from All Hail King Jesus to advance their goal of Increasing Championship Odds. However, Market Reality analysis confirms that no mutually beneficial deal exists. Amon-Ra St. Brown is an unlisted franchise cornerstone for All Hail King Jesus, a team actively competing in Playoff Push mode. Prying him away would require Badland Banditos to surrender Kenneth Walker or Bucky Irving, which would force Sean Tucker (34.2 C-AVI) into Banditos' starting lineup at RB2 and net-lower Banditos' starting lineup score from 626.3 to 601.7 C-AVI. Conversely, offering non-RB assets fails All Hail King Jesus's contender lineup replacement requirements. Therefore, AVI determines No Realistic Trade and advises Banditos to pursue WR upgrades elsewhere while preserving running back depth.

submitted.summary: Attempting to acquire Amon-Ra St. Brown requires surrendering Kenneth Walker, Brian Thomas, and a 2027 1st round pick. While this theoretical package provides fair gross value, giving up Walker leaves Badland Banditos with Sean Tucker (34.2 C-AVI) as their starting RB2, causing a 24.6 C-AVI drop in starting lineup score (626.3 to 601.7) and directly damaging Banditos' championship odds. Meanwhile, All Hail King Jesus (also a playoff contender) cannot afford to trade away their cornerstone WR1 without creating a wide receiver ceiling void.

analysis.executiveSummary: To acquire reigning Offensive Player of the Year Jaxon Smith-Njigba (99.1 C-AVI / 99.6 D-AVI) from All Hail King Jesus, Conquistadors can offer a balanced package centered on WR George Pickens (92.8 C-AVI), a high-end 2027 1st Round Pick (Northside Kings orig5, 79.3 AVI), and RB Tyjae Spears (50.5 C-AVI). In a 16-team league, All Hail King Jesus has a severe weakness at running back (starting 31-year-old Aaron Jones and Zach Charbonnet) while locking up two elite WRs in JSN and Amon-Ra St. Brown. This proposal gives them a young WR1 replacement in Pickens, immediate RB depth in Spears, and a premium 2027 1st round pick to reload or acquire a star RB, while creating the undisputed #1 WR pairing in the league for Conquistadors (Puka Nacua + JSN) to push for the championship.

submitted.summary: Conquistadors trade concentrated value (Pickens + 2027 1st + Spears) to secure an elite, top-tier asset in Jaxon Smith-Njigba. Upgrading WR2 from George Pickens (92.8 C-AVI) to JSN (99.1 C-AVI) pairs with Puka Nacua (99.6 C-AVI), Josh Allen (99.6 C-AVI), and Bijan Robinson (99.4 C-AVI) to form an unrivaled championship core. All Hail King Jesus gains essential roster depth, a starter-caliber WR, and liquid future draft capital to solve their starting RB crisis.

marketReality.explanation: Though JSN is not explicitly listed on the trade block, All Hail King Jesus's urgent need for running back help and draft capital makes this package a compelling, realistic offer that solves roster imbalance without forcing a complete rebuild.

verdict.rationale: For Conquistadors, acquiring Jaxon Smith-Njigba creates a starting lineup with four 99+ C-AVI players (Josh Allen, Bijan Robinson, Puka Nacua, JSN). Upgrading WR2 from Pickens to JSN significantly elevates weekly championship ceiling while keeping the core intact. The cost (Pickens + 2027 1st + Spears) is substantial but completely justified for your stated goal to Win Championship.
